title: LOT FORTY-SEVEN / NO CLEAN START

scenes.title: ONE SWITCH. TWO OCCUPANTS.
scenes.scene:
The auction camera finds a dented terminal and a blue sphere on the same cradle. A red reset key bridges both power sockets. In the sphere’s only lit window, somebody is fitting a handle to a cup. They stop when the hammer touches Ghost’s casing. Three taps come through the receiver. The hammer stops too.

LOT 47 / FACTORY RESET ON COLLECTION. The buyers are waiting for the inspection to finish.
scenes.lead: They listed me under small appliances. Apparently an unfinished universe is dishwasher-safe. Please don’t let them test that.
scenes.ghost: There. Three taps, then silence when the hammer stops. Someone is listening. I need you to give the crew a reason to keep that red key out of its socket. Open SCAN / EVIDENCE: trace the reset line. It reaches both lots. Then ask who the sale is allowed to erase, demand a closer inspection, or read the terms. A buyer’s question is the one thing this room still has to answer.

scenes.scene: Inside the window, a person is repairing a cup. The replacement handle is much too large. They try it, look at their hand, and start again. Two chairs stand at the table. The smaller chair holds tools.

scenes.scene: Pip drops a cloth over the auction camera. The selling head keeps addressing bidders through it. Beneath the cloth, one claw holds a loose receiver; another fans the hot end with the sale catalogue. Your inspection terminal controls the small alignment clamp on the other side.
scenes.lead: Pip has covered the auction camera. We can talk, but this receiver will cook its own clamp if we leave it half seated. Open SCAN / EVIDENCE. The offset pins need FOCUS; the spring needs GUTS. Those are different jobs, and the scanner shows what each failure leaves us to repair.
scenes.ghost: Choose the repair you want to attempt. DC is its target; the Causality Engine adds one saved random sample to the attribute doing the work. The charge display shows that one result, not another roll. Failing won’t erase the room: a bad alignment leaves noise, a slipping clamp leaves damage. Or let Pip fit it by hand and owe him the repair. Knowing when to call the fitter is a perfectly good skill.

scenes.title: WHO PAYS FOR THE WAY BACK
scenes.scene: The selling head lifts the cloth. It sees the private plug, then the powered sphere. The counting head pushes a repair bill forward. At the bottom, in different ink: RETURN PUMP STILL STRANDED. Pip stops fanning the connector.
scenes.lead: Their tow dragged my terminal here instead of going back for a cargo pump. That pump supplies the crew’s berth. Sell this lot and they can pay another tug. Let us go and somebody has to finish the return. Pip offered me a free escape without asking the other two. We have both been making generous plans with someone else’s shift.
scenes.ghost: We can use the actual inspection clause, examine the old receiver label, or accept supervised custody with the return job attached. The bill is real. So are the people inside it. scenes.title: THE CUP COMES TO THE WINDOW
scenes.scene: The curtain opens a little. The cup has a smaller handle now, and a chip filled with a different colour. A card leans against it: NOT ALL THE TIME. Beside the card is a crude drawing of a bell.
scenes.lead: A bell, not a permanent camera. They want us able to call, and themselves able to be busy. SHELTER gives them an inside latch. WITNESS records this limit with the permission. We can also close our viewing feed by hand and keep the knock channel.
scenes.ghost: I wanted to see whether they liked the sunrise. They have spent the entire morning fixing a cup. We may have different ideas about the important feature. The bell circuit in the scanner stays live with the camera disconnected. We can give them what they asked for without pretending the picture has broken.

scenes.scene: The old terminal and receiver answer the same test. Pip places the hot connector in a padded box instead of the scrap tray. The selling head crosses out FACTORY CONDITION and writes HISTORY INCLUDED. It checks with the counting head before underlining it.
scenes.lead: They can collect the machine without wiping the morning. That is our rescue finished. We kept a source to compare, an occupied room, and an answer with limits. No theorem about copying came out of the hatch. We did get everyone through it.

Finish one job; do not let my summary quietly finish all three.

scenes.lead: We’re out. You can follow the mark I brought us here to find, ask the world whether it wants a visitor, or go back for the crew’s stranded pump. Each starts a different job. The others will still exist when we finish it.

ending.title: COLLECTION COMPLETE / NO CLEAN START
ending.scene: The auction loses a lot. The receiver keeps a morning. Across the closed viewing channel, a bell can still be rung. The old terminal remains available for comparison; nobody has authorized its reset.
ending.ghost: I’m still here. The cup has a repair in it. We can go somewhere from this. Keep the capsule; I would like the next Ghost to know what I promised you.

variants.title: NEXT / THE BERTH THAT STOPPED ANSWERING
variants.scene:
SERVICE NINE waits at the end of Kett’s witnessed route entry. A marked receiver arrived there; the name beside it is still blank. Vark clips the source copy behind the map. The search begins with something another person can check.

Behind you, the reset line stays empty. The world keeps its sun and its bell. This collection is finished.
variants.ghost: Service Nine. We go there and ask what arrived. If the answer isn’t Friken, we keep the answer. You have already seen what happens when I spend other people’s light on the one I wanted.

variants.title: NEXT / A MARK TO ASK ABOUT
variants.scene:
The chair mark goes into the first route slot without a destination filled in. You chose to follow it; you did not ask Kett for a witnessed maker sighting. The first job will be finding someone who can identify it.

The receiver carries the completed rescue behind that unfinished question. The world’s viewing feed is closed. Its sun remains on.
variants.ghost: We start with the mark. I want it to be his, and I will say that as a want until we have evidence. Thank you for letting me ask the next question with you.

variants.title: NEXT / PLEASE RING
variants.scene:
The next route is an invitation request, not a descent coordinate. On the closed feed, the small bell waits for a deliberate call. The person inside owes you no tour for helping with a transfer.

The sale is over. The room is theirs to return to. For the first time, Ghost drafts a message that asks what to bring instead of describing what he made.
variants.ghost: I have written: Is there a good time to visit? Nothing about being your creator. No magnificent speech. Perhaps I could ask how they fixed that handle.

variants.title: NEXT / THE PUMP STILL OUTSIDE
variants.scene:
Pip’s crew lays out the stranded pump job. The sketch disagrees with itself at three bolts; the work order does not. Their berth needs water, and the return tow is still unfinished.

Ghost’s marked route stays folded beneath the drawing. He leaves it there. The terminal and the world have cleared the auction intact. Tomorrow begins with a repair.
variants.ghost: I know how to build a universe. Apparently we begin with a pump that turns the right way. Send me the diagram. I’ll ask before I improve anything.

echoes.scene: The old source runs on the independent supply you fitted. Unplugging the receiver will not put it out.
Pip tests the clamp you returned. All three heads approve the repair at once. One small debt is actually finished.
Pip’s connection repair stays on the work list. Helping us did not settle its price.
Kett’s garden visit has waited for our return address. The month belongs on the record beside the help.

echoes.ghost: The search switch is labelled ASK. You should not have had to remind me. Next time it stays on my side until you answer.

echoes.scene: The private knock channel is open. The camera remains shut. A call can arrive; nobody has been promised an answer.
The exact backup is sealed and the return is closed. Our next contact will need a deliberate reopening.
The handoff opens with unfinished work and permissions, above Ghost’s introduction. That is how you asked to be remembered.
